verdict.rationale: Apple's docs mention Spotlight as a way to search and take action without opening apps, which covers the launcher part, and Shortcuts for automating tasks. Nothing in the evidence documents system-wide hotkeys, full keyboard navigation, or keyboard-driven window management, and community users turn to third-party tools like Moom for window control. missing for 10: documented system-wide keyboard shortcuts/hotkeys, full keyboard access to all UI elements, keyboard-driven window management, independent hands-on corroboration of keyboard-only operation
